hypothesis: A matched current streaming implementation comparison can identify scalar-text work-charge changes while preserving the exact deterministic ODS archive.
classification: Matched current-revision streaming evidence; no speedup or causal optimization claim is authorized by the protocol alone.
timing_scope: Create deterministic scalar row inputs, author content, validate publication, compress/finalize package, and write to hashing discard sink. Exclude artifact creation/reopen oracle, procfs probes, sink construction and digest extraction.
preservation_scope: Fresh one-sheet scalar documents only; no existing source or unknown content is modified.
comparison_scope: Control and candidate use the same streaming selector and deterministic four-cell rows. Exact archive bytes, target XML bytes, output hashes, semantic rows, member-set/reopen gates, and sink accepted bytes must agree by shape, mode, and repeat before any performance comparison.
allocator_policy: serialized_region_peak_v3; derive regional peak minus entry; normal binaries own latency claims; allocator elapsed time is descriptive; process maximum RSS includes setup and oracle.

uncertainty.normal_latency_p50: deterministic bootstrap 95% CI over the retained 30 samples, 2000 resamples, fixed seed 434
uncertainty.allocator: raw vectors and descriptive min/median/max only; no allocator elapsed-latency claim

ambient_binding: Each report environment.git_revision and git_worktree_dirty value is retained as runtime checkout evidence. The outer verifier requires one identical ambient checkout identity across all 24 reports and binds the executable revision/source manifest to the role build.json separately; the ambient checkout revision is not substituted for the binary build revision.

oracle.note: The copied 0433 semantic verifier and protocol are immutable oracle inputs; the outer 0434 verifier owns revision and cross-phase identity.

cross_phase_identity.scope: same shape, mode, and repeat across before-streaming and after-streaming

profile_scope.scope: whole fresh process including setup, corpus generation, warmups, measured samples, output hashing, and harness oracle; diagnostic only and not operation-local evidence
profile_scope.p50_uncertainty: Use uncertainty.normal_latency_p50; profiles do not establish a speedup claim.
